title: UI graph
description: facts.ui in asbuilt/facts.json: the controls of each screen named in designc.json ui.screens, read from source with the TypeScript compiler (extract/ui.js). Display only: never a gate input, finding, DSL line or fingerprint input. Nothing is guessed: what the source cannot show is null and listed in unresolved. docs/ui-graph.example.json is the fixture output, pinned in test/extract-ui.test.js. Fields marked 'later' are added by later slices of phase 7 and are absent until then.

screen.description: Absent for problems that concern no one screen (tsconfig, compiler).

repo.description: Which repository: codebase, or a designc.json references key (later, 7e).

roots.description: Repo-relative source files the screen's patterns match, sorted.

components.description: Component ids declared in the roots.

name.description: The capitalised function, arrow const or class; a default export with no name, or JSX outside any component, takes the module name (file, or folder for index).

renders.description: Capitalised JSX tags it renders, sorted. Followed in 7b.

role.description: Null when the source cannot show it; an unresolved entry says why.

basis.description: native: the HTML element's implicit role. aria: a literal role attribute. followed (7b), mapped (7e) later.

name.description: The accessible name when a literal decides it: the first source present in the order aria-labelledby, aria-label, label, alt, text, value, title, placeholder. Null when that source is an expression or t('key').

value.description: Literal text, the i18n key for t(), or null for an expression.

expr.description: Source text of the expression when value is null.

spreads.description: How many {...props} spreads the element has (their attributes are not read in 7a).
